Hidden Retries: Are there any silent Firebase retry policies or recursive loops in the background worker that could be artificially inflating token usage beyond what the final database payload reports?

Ledger Accuracy: Briefly audit the calculateTelemetryForUser logic. Why did it output $0.1497 when the raw token counts suggest a different total?
